metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: Benefits-Renewal Service Design
decision.domain: Behavioral and decision science, causal inference, and public policy
decision.question: Choose a renewal intervention that improves eligible-household completion while limiting cost, autonomy intrusion, access gaps, and implementation risk.
blocking_reasons: evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

current-renewal.label: Current renewal process
current-renewal.description: Retain the existing form, notices, and in-person support.

smart-reminders.label: Behaviorally informed reminders
smart-reminders.description: Use simplified, timed, multilingual reminders with implementation intentions.

automatic-renewal.label: Automatic renewal with opt-out
automatic-renewal.description: Renew administratively eligible households by default with notice and an opt-out.

simplified-assistance.label: Simplified form plus assisted renewal
simplified-assistance.description: Pre-fill verified fields, shorten the form, and add multilingual phone and community assistance.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.type: Synthetic randomized-pilot estimates and implementation scenarios
evidence.as_of: Synthetic demonstration; no production as-of date
evidence.causal_claim_status: Intervention effects are framed as hypothetical randomized-pilot estimates; no real program effect is claimed.
limitations: Welfare effects are not equivalent to observed completion behavior.
Digital access and language needs are represented with coarse groups.
Long-run administrative learning is not modeled.
The Gaussian copula and factor loadings are synthetic assumptions; tail dependence may differ in real data and requires domain approval.

decision_notes: A real evaluation should pre-specify the eligible population, estimand, primary outcome, subgroup analysis, and spillover checks.
Completion is not automatically welfare-improving; eligibility accuracy, consent, and appeal rights remain central.
